scope: Only canonical original items represented by 312 render states; not a full item engine.

contract.sourceItemId: Item constructor index + 256; TileItem ctor uses tileId - 256
contract.renderIndex: zero-based terrain-catalog entries index; independent of itemIndex
contract.itemIndex: zero-based kItems index; always carried explicitly in UI entries
contract.defaultData: Original item placement metadata; may differ from representative render data (persistent leaves)
contract.creative: Exact membership in original nondebug Common/Iggy creative ITEM/ITEM_AUX list
contract.placeable: Supported representative block placement only; NOT full upstream useOn/food/physics behavior
contract.unknown: itemForBlockState and index/render helpers return -1; findItem returns nullptr

implemented: Item identity: ID (256 + ctor index), icon name, source class and symbol.
Stack limit 1 for all 25 tools and 20 armor pieces, read from the upstream constructors.
Durability NUMBERS are recorded (tier uses; armor healthPerSlot x multiplier) as read-only data.
Armor defense NUMBERS per slot, matching Inventory::getArmorValue summation semantics.
Attack damage NUMBERS (subclass base + tier bonus); the hoe has none upstream.
Inventory/hotbar carrying and crafting-table recipe matching.
notImplemented: Durability CONSUMPTION. Slot has no damage field; persisting wear needs an inventory format upgrade.
Mining speed/time. World::mine is creative-instant, so tier speed changes nothing.
Harvest-level gating. canDestroySpecial is not consulted; any tool breaks any block.
Enchantments. enchantmentValue is recorded but no enchanting path exists.
Armor damage reduction. There is no player health/damage path to reduce.
Sword combat bonuses. Scene applies no equipment bonus to attacks.
Hoe tilling and shears shearing. Both need useOn, which is not implemented.
Armor equipping. Inventory exposes only a const armor getter and no equip API.
toolArmorScope.survivalReachability: Iron and gold ingots are obtainable ONLY by smelting (FurnaceRecipes.cpp:20-21) and smelting is not implemented in this round. Iron/gold/chain gear and every iron-ingot recipe are therefore UNREACHABLE through survival play and can only be obtained by creative give. Wood and stone tools are fully reachable; diamond gear is reachable because diamonds drop directly from ore.
toolArmorScope.chainArmor: Chain armor exists as four items with correct defense/durability but has NO recipe: the upstream ArmorRecipes.cpp:45-71 chain entries are commented out.

limitations: Tools and armor are identity/stat data plus recipes only; see toolArmorScope.notImplemented.
No buckets, entities, consumable food, NBT, smelting, or general item engine.
Source useOn prerequisites/physics are not executed by this catalog.
Source-pinned rules fail closed on changed input, new states, IDs or item classes.
Canonical mappings are pick/source-item identity, not original random block drops.
Empty flower pot uses aux 0, deliberately not upstream cloneTileData returning item ID.
Legacy oak stone slab 44:2 is registered and preserved but absent from original creative list.
